context: Asuka discusses creative writing methods with Sakura.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: writing lecture; vocabulary (やり方/創造/見方/新規/信用) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 物語の作り方が、分からなくて。
lines.en: I can't figure out how to make a story.
lines.style: troubled adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: やり方は、一つではありませんよ。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 創造には、何が必要ですか?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 新しい見方を、持つことが創造の鍵です。
lines.en: Holding a new perspective is the key to creation.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 新規の発想は、どう生まれますか?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 日常を、別の見方で見るんです。
lines.en: You see the everyday from a different view.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 自分のやり方を、信用していいですか?
lines.en: Can I trust my own way?
lines.style: earnest adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、自分を信用して、創造を続けて。
lines.en: Yes, trust yourself and keep creating.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured encouraging closing clarity throughout
